note: Which catalog tools each agent role may call, per task type (design note 2026-09-08 section 7; loader rails.tools.load_toolkit_table). Every id resolves in rails.tools.TOOL_CATALOG and is checked by scripts/checks/engineering_base_check.py. The Solver has no row: the Solver is the frozen core behind the single door and calls no tool. An empty list means that role calls nothing yet, which is a statement, not an omission. WAVE R7 (2026-09-08): the tool-call rows carry the eighteen rails/a2t_* renderers the reuse map's Group A named -- registered, never rebuilt (rails/tool_wrappers/a2t_renderers.py). The Planner reads the knowledge grounds and the prompt/response envelopes, the Observer the two state organizers, and the Reviewer the hard-validity check that used to be a private branch inside a retired controller. OWNER016 adds two command task-action primitives; OWNER017 adds admitted corrective-memory guidance for the command Planner. Their fixed/core selection is enabled only by phase_tools; catalog membership alone does not execute them. OPT-IN v2 adds candidate-contract lookup to command and tool-call planners; the historical v1 table remains unchanged. OWNER023 adds cached full-utterance speech observations to command and tool-call Observers. Explicit phase_tools and a finalized source-bound catalog are required; membership does not execute ASR. Native action programs may expose the distinct live speech observation tool; it performs no work until the frozen core selects it and the registered custodian records the invocation.
